summary: TOYO Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a planned CFO transition. Chief Financial Officer Mr. Raymond Chung will resign in Q3 2026, with Mr. Yasunari Harada as identified successor. The change is not due to any disagreement but aligns with the company's long-term strategic priorities including U.S. expansion. Mr. Harada brings over 30 years of banking and capital markets experience. The appointment is subject to board approval. Watch for formal appointment and board resolution in Q3 2026; no risk-arb angle as this is a routine succession event.
